# MM-P3-L4-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01

Scope
- Routine maintenance and verification procedures for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) to ensure safe operation and consistent product quality during heat treat downstream operations.
- Refer to SB-1028 for safety boundaries and lockout/tagout requirements prior to maintenance activities.

Tools
- Hydraulic torque wrench compatible with 605 N·m.
- Bearing lubrication pump and manufacturer-recommended lubricant.
- Standard hand tools and inspection mirror.
- Personal protective equipment per SB-1028 and SOP-P3-L4-02.

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out the mill per SB-1028 before any maintenance. Verify isolation with authorized personnel as directed in SOP-P3-L4-02.
- Inspect mandrel clamp assembly for wear, cracks, and secure fasteners. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m.
- Tighten mandrel clamp bolts using the hydraulic torque wrench to the value above. Confirm each bolt reaches target torque; if a bolt does not achieve target torque, remove, inspect threads, and replace per SOP-P3-L4-03.
- Clean main roll bearing housings of contaminants and apply lubricant through specified fittings. The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 160 hours.
- Record lubrication events and any bearing condition observations in the equipment log. If abnormal vibration or noise is detected after lubrication, follow diagnostic flow in SOP-P3-L4-03.
- Reassemble guards and verify interlocks function per SOP-P3-L4-02. Release lockout only after completion of checks and documentation.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts achieve and hold the specified torque without evidence of slippage or loosening.
- Main roll bearings show reduced contamination, proper lubricant presence, and no abnormal noise or vibration following procedure.
- Maintenance actions and verification recorded in the equipment log. Any failures to meet criteria must be escalated and documented per SOP-P3-L4-03.
